name: Off-Road Vehicle
description: Any wheeled or tracked motorized vehicle designed or adapted for cross-country travel over natural terrain, dirt-bikes, trail-bikes and mini-bikes included, and a motorcycle while it's ridden off a highway; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria is one.

restrictions.rule: Designed or adapted for cross-country travel on land, snow, ice or other natural terrain; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: The Off-Road Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. O31, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Registered and plated with Manitoba Public Insurance, with its liability insurance premium paid, except on land its owner owns or leases
restrictions.citation: The Off-Road Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. O31, s. 3; The Drivers and Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. D104, ss. 71(a) and 77(1)

restrictions.rule: Riders under 14 must be supervised and accompanied by, and in clear view of, a parent or an adult the parent authorizes
restrictions.citation: The Off-Road Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. O31, s. 26(1)

restrictions.rule: Riding a road-registrable motorcycle off-road takes a rider 16 or older with a licence not restricted from off-road vehicles
restrictions.citation: The Off-Road Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. O31, s. 26(3)

restrictions.rule: Every rider and passenger must wear a properly adjusted and fastened helmet meeting the regulations
restrictions.citation: The Off-Road Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. O31, s. 28(1)

restrictions.rule: Carries no more people than it was designed for
restrictions.citation: The Off-Road Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. O31, s. 27

restrictions.rule: Kept off roadways, shoulders, divided highway medians, interchanges and sidewalks, except to cross directly where the Act allows; crossing a roadway takes a licence not restricted from off-road vehicles
restrictions.citation: The Off-Road Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. O31, ss. 33(1) and 35
